Native StimGate right-tail density shoulder gate

Source: R/cp_uns_loc_filtering.R
dot-getStimGateTailgate.Rd

This helper defines the native StimGate tailgate rule: after the main peak, locate the steepest negative derivative on the descending shoulder and report the first point at which the density has flattened to the requested fraction of that slope. This relative-derivative rule preserves the local-FDR shape threshold behaviour and deliberately does not use a fixed absolute tolerance like the cytoUtils:::.cytokine_cutpoint() tol gate.

Usage

.getStimGateTailgate(density, peakX = NULL, fraction = 1/200)
